# core-energy.js - vendored, unmodified

A byte-for-byte copy of `Reference/Core-Energy-Portfolio/core-energy.js`, the
energy core IKN supplied as the reference for screen 1.

**Do not edit this file.** It is the reference itself, with its particle data
and fallback image embedded. To change the core, change the reference and copy
it here again; to change how it sits on the vault, edit
`src/stage/ambient/vaulthud/reference-core.ts`.

SHA-256 at the time it was copied:
`53bc384a347737e619c76ff73669f2c1639d0e7e731518c75a0c638333a628ba`

It defines the `<portfolio-energy-core>` custom element. Its own documentation,
requirements and verification report are in `Reference/Core-Energy-Portfolio/`.
